svg.title: Bird Bend Stand wiring — sheet 1: System overview
svg.text: 48 V / MAINS DOMAIN — PSU 0 V, driver GND and PE are NEVER connected to logic GND
LOGIC DOMAIN — logic GND star point (Nucleo GND = HX711 GND = input cells = opto returns)
isolation barrier: driver optos ≥ 500 MΩ · DC-DC ≥ 1.5 kV
closed loop: SW7 off / SW8 on
switch positions schematic; actuation beyond the
Keli DEF 200 kg load cell, 3.0 mV/V
tension + compression, in the load path (table ↔ specimen ↔ frame)
input cells, ENA diode OR: sheet 3
close to the Nucleo, wires ≤ 20 cm
cell cable 5 m, 4-wire + shield (do not shorten)
logic GND star point at the Nucleo GND:
· Nucleo GND = HX711 GND = input-cell GND = +5V_CUT 0 V
· opto returns PUL− DIR− ENA− ALM− PEND− (common cathode, D-17)
· the PC ground enters through the USB / ST-LINK
· NEVER connect logic GND to the driver 48 V GND, the PSU 0 V or PE
· motor cable shield → driver PE at the driver end
· control cable shield → logic GND at the board end only
· load-cell shield (yellow) → HX711 GND only; keep the cell cable
≥ 10–20 cm from motor / 48 V wires, cross at 90°
DRV_PWR 48 V presence sense (PA7, drv.pwr_sense_enable = 0) · TRIP relay (PB9 retired)
Source: 01_HW/wiring.md v0.7 · 01_HW/pinout.md v0.6 · DECISIONS D-27, D-41, D-42, D-56
